title: To and from
summary: Say where people go with the dative `-A` and where they come from with the ablative `-dAn`, including the dative merged with a final vowel (*Mara*, *ejä*), and use both cases on the pronouns: *maňa*, *menden*.
canDo: Say where you are going, and ask where someone is going
Say where you come from and where you are coming from
Talk about buses, trains, taxis and the way to a place
Say who you are looking at, waiting for, helping or believing
